notes.text: Aleksander Barkov returned in their last game after missing 22 games. Their recent numbers were built mostly without him.

The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 10 games cover only 20% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the lowest share in the league (a typical team: 38%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Jordan Kyrou is on injured reserve (upper body injury) and missed their last game. He is one of their most valuable skaters.

Rasmus Sandin is out long term and has missed the last 18 games. He is a top-four defenseman. Timothy Liljegren has taken his spot beside Martin Fehérváry. That pair has had 56% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 130:46 together.
Jakob Chychrun has started killing penalties: on the ice for 25% of the team’s shorthanded time in 22 games, up from 8% last season.

story.head: The Capitals can’t afford to take penalties
paras: The Capitals won the teams’ first meeting this season, 4-3 in Washington on Nov 7. The Capitals (11-11-0) beat Philadelphia 7-3 on Wednesday, and the Panthers have won two in a row. Going in, the Cats are fifth in the Atlantic (tied for tenth in the NHL) and the Capitals sixth in the Metropolitan (25th).

The Panthers’ record (.620) is about what their chances are worth. The Capitals have played better than their record (.500) says: their chances are worth about .582, and losses in one-goal games have held them back.

The Panthers forecheck harder than anyone (1st) and rarely ice the puck (1st), but don’t block many shots (32nd). On the other side, the Capitals get their shots through to the net (5th), but give up a lot of dangerous shots (29th). They also get some of the league’s best looks (3rd), so the Capitals wait for good looks, but the Panthers settle for hopeful ones. Washington has allowed 3.91 goals a game, the second most in the league. The Panthers’ power play (3rd) could do real damage against the Capitals’ penalty kill (26th).

Matthew Tkachuk (7 G / 26 A / 33 P in 25 GP) leads the Panthers in scoring and is tied for ninth in the NHL. Sam Reinhart (12 G / 11 A / 23 P in 25 GP) has a team-high twelve goals, with six goals in ten games against Washington since 2023-24. For the Capitals, Alex Tuch (15 G / 5 A / 20 P in 22 GP) leads the way in scoring, with seven points in his last five games and a point in six straight games against Florida. Ryan Leonard (10 G / 9 A / 19 P in 22 GP) is next in line, with seven points in his last five games.
Jacob Markström (8-4-1 / .893 SV% in 14 GS) is expected to start for Florida, and Logan Thompson (8-6-0 / .878 SV% in 16 GS) for Washington.
